problem:
Using the change of variables 

$$
u=y-3x,\,v=y+2x,
$$

calculate the area of the finite region $D$ in the first quadrant bounded by the lines

$$
y=3x-2,\,y=3x+2,\,y=1-2x,\,y=3-2x.
$$
